scripts.clone: await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('210:7'));await figma.loadFontAsync({family:'Noto Sans Symbols 2',style:'Regular'});const src=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(SOURCE);for(const t of src.findAll(n=>n.type==='TEXT'))for(const s of t.getStyledTextSegments(['fontName']))await figma.loadFontAsync(s.fontName);const out=[];for(const [i,v]of ['en-light','zh-dark','en-dark'].entries()){const n=src.clone();figma.currentPage.appendChild(n);n.name='Core · '+KEY+' · '+v;n.x=8000+i*470;n.y=14644+INDEX*1040;out.push({key:KEY,variant:v,id:n.id,source:src.id,createdNodeIds:[n.id,...n.findAll(()=>true).map(n=>n.id)]});}return out;
scripts.textContrast: await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('210:7'));const ids=[];for(const F of FS){const r=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(F.id);for(const t of r.findAll(n=>n.type==='TEXT')){if(Array.isArray(t.fills)&&t.fills.some(p=>p.type==='SOLID'&&p.color.r+p.color.g+p.color.b<1.1)){for(const s of t.getStyledTextSegments(['fontName']))await figma.loadFontAsync(s.fontName);t.fills=[{type:'SOLID',color:{r:245/255,g:245/255,b:245/255}}];ids.push(t.id);}}}return {mutatedNodeIds:ids};
